name: From All Sides – Catalyst Spatial Sound Forum 2026
description: Catalyst's annual Spatial Sound Forum explores spatial sound as a practice shaped by bodies, rooms and shared attention. Framed by the theme 'Gradients of Ma,' the 2026 edition focuses on intervals, pauses and quiet as active space. The programme includes immersive Atmos sessions, interactive installations, live and fixed media concerts, workshops, talks and conversations questioning what spatial sound means beyond format or technology. Features performances from artists including CTN, Eleonor Bianchi, Sibu Manaï, and more.
